tasks.subject: Task 1: lock module with flock-based cloud lock
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Self-contained `lock` module providing `Wait`, `CloudLock`, `acquire`/`acquire_at`, with tests.

**Files:** apps/rmapps/Cargo.toml, apps/rmapps/src/lock.rs (create), apps/rmapps/src/main.rs (register mod lock)

```json:metadata
{"files": ["apps/rmapps/Cargo.toml", "apps/rmapps/src/lock.rs", "apps/rmapps/src/main.rs"], "verifyCommand": "nix develop --command cargo test -p rmapps lock", "acceptanceCriteria": ["fail-fast errors while held with pid+op", "release on drop", "block waits then succeeds"], "requiresUserVerification": false}
```

tasks.subject: Task 2: Wire the lock into one-shot commands and the watch daemon
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Acquire the lock at exactly one layer per process: one-shots fail-fast in main.rs; watch blocks per task.

**Files:** apps/rmapps/src/main.rs, apps/rmapps/src/watch/mod.rs

```json:metadata
{"files": ["apps/rmapps/src/main.rs", "apps/rmapps/src/watch/mod.rs"], "verifyCommand": "nix develop --command cargo test -p rmapps", "acceptanceCriteria": ["one-shots fail-fast, auth/ls/watch unlocked at dispatch", "watch scheduled per-task block", "watch reactive job block", "builds + tests pass"], "requiresUserVerification": false}
```
